note: **3 Pelham Cottage, Barrack Lane, schedule 207 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** Edith Annie Hind, hosiery shirt machinist, bound to the woman the record has followed since 1881.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A

census.source: 1939 Register, schedule 207, 3 Pelham Cottage, Barrack Lane, ED letter code RMGB, Nottingham registration district 430-3, sub-district 26, The National Archives RG101/6178A - read from the page by A. Hagues; sub number 1; the index gives her as Edith A and her trade as Housiery Shirt Machinist; she is the Edith Annie Hind the record holds from 1881 onwards, a hosiery machinist in 1911 and a hosiery worker, maker up, in 1921, born 1879 on every round. Her line is RG101/6178A, item 20, line 6, immediately below Arthur William Smith at number 2
